create_card.description: Create a new virtual or physical Brex card. For a vendor card with its own spending limit, set the limit type to CARD. For an employee card that uses the person's existing limit, set the limit type to USER.
create_card.name: create_card

parameters.description: The ID of the user the card is issued to. You can find user IDs with the List Brex users action.
parameters.name: owner_user_id

parameters.description: Display name for the card (e.g. 'AWS - Vendor').
parameters.name: card_name

parameters.description: Choose VIRTUAL or PHYSICAL. Vendor cards must be VIRTUAL.
parameters.name: card_type

parameters.description: Choose CARD (a vendor card with its own limit) or USER (a corporate card that uses the person's limit). If you choose CARD, the spend limit amount and spend duration are required.
parameters.name: limit_type

parameters.description: Required when the limit type is CARD. Enter the amount in the smallest currency unit (for example, cents for USD, so 50000 means $500).
parameters.name: spend_limit_amount

parameters.description: Three-letter currency code, for example USD. Default is USD.
parameters.name: spend_limit_currency

parameters.description: Required when the limit type is CARD. How long the spend limit applies: MONTHLY, QUARTERLY, YEARLY, or ONE_TIME.
parameters.name: spend_duration

parameters.description: The reason for the spend limit.
parameters.name: reason

parameters.description: The card locks automatically after this date. Use the format yyyy-mm-dd, for example 2026-12-31.
parameters.name: lock_after_date

parameters.description: Required for physical cards. The shipping details, with these fields: recipient_name, phone_number, and address (which contains line1, line2, city, state, postal_code, and country).
parameters.name: mailing_address

id.description: New card ID. Use as card_id in subsequent actions (list_card_transactions filter, future lock/terminate).

last_four.description: Last four digits of the new card.

spend_controls.description: Echoes the input spend_controls when limit_type=CARD.

get_expense.description: Fetch a single card expense by ID.
get_expense.name: get_expense

parameters.description: The ID of the expense. You can find it with the List Brex expenses or List Brex card transactions actions.
parameters.name: expense_id

parameters.description: Extra details to include with the expense. Options: merchant, location, department, receipts.download_uris, user, budget, payment, spending_entity, policy.
parameters.name: expand

returns.description: A single Brex expense object. Same shape as one entry of list_expenses.items.

list_card_transactions.description: List settled transactions on the primary card account. Pending transactions are not included. Regular users can only see their own purchase, refund, and chargeback transactions.
list_card_transactions.name: list_card_transactions

parameters.description: Only include transactions made by these users. You can find user IDs with the List Brex users action.
parameters.name: user_ids

parameters.description: Only include transactions posted at or after this time (for example, 2026-04-01T00:00:00Z).
parameters.name: posted_at_start

parameters.description: To get the next page of results, enter the next_cursor value from the previous run.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: How many results to return per page, up to 100. Default is 50.
parameters.name: limit

amount.description: Money object: {amount, currency}. Negative for refunds, positive for purchases.

card_id.description: Card the transaction was made on. Null for REWARDS_CREDIT or COLLECTION. Resolves via list_cards (items[].id).

card_metadata.description: Free-form key-value string map associated with the card. Max 50 keys.

description.description: Merchant descriptor as it appears on the statement.

initiated_at_date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) the transaction was initiated.

posted_at_date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) the transaction settled and posted.

type.description: Transaction type. Enum: PURCHASE, REFUND, CHARGEBACK, REWARDS_CREDIT, COLLECTION, BNPL_FEE.

list_cards.description: List Brex cards, optionally filtered by user.
list_cards.name: list_cards

parameters.description: Only include cards owned by this user. You can find user IDs with the List Brex users action.
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.description: To get the next page of results, enter the next_cursor value from the previous run.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: How many results to return per page, up to 100. Default is 50.
parameters.name: limit

card_name.description: Display name set at creation time.

id.description: Card ID. Use as card_id to filter list_card_transactions, and (in future Tier 2 actions) lock/unlock/terminate/update.

last_four.description: Last four digits of the PAN.

limit_type.description: CARD (vendor cards with their own spend_controls) | USER (corp cards using user-level limits).

owner.description: {type: 'USER', user_id: string}. user_id resolves via list_users.

spend_controls.description: Present when limit_type=CARD. {spend_limit: {amount, currency}, spend_duration: MONTHLY|QUARTERLY|YEARLY|ONE_TIME, reason, lock_after_date}.

list_expenses.description: List card expenses, with optional filters by user, budget, status, payment status, and purchase date range. Results come back one page at a time.
list_expenses.name: list_expenses

parameters.description: Only include expenses owned by these users. You can find user IDs with the List Brex users action.
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.description: Filter to expenses charged against these budget IDs.
parameters.name: budget_id

parameters.description: Only include expenses that belong to these parent expenses.
parameters.name: parent_expense_id

parameters.description: Only include expenses with these statuses: DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, OUT_OF_POLICY, VOID, CANCELED, SPLIT, or SETTLED.
parameters.name: expense_status

parameters.description: Only include expenses with these payment statuses: NOT_STARTED, PROCESSING, CANCELED, DECLINED, CLEARED, REFUNDING, REFUNDED, CASH_ADVANCE, CREDITED, AWAITING_PAYMENT, or SCHEDULED.
parameters.name: payment_status

parameters.description: Only include expenses purchased at or after this time (for example, 2026-04-01T00:00:00Z).
parameters.name: purchased_at_start

parameters.description: Only include expenses purchased up to this time (for example, 2026-04-30T00:00:00Z).
parameters.name: purchased_at_end

parameters.description: Extra details to include with each expense. Options: merchant, location, department, receipts.download_uris, user, budget, payment, spending_entity, policy.
parameters.name: expand

parameters.description: To get the next page of results, enter the next_cursor value from the previous run.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: How many results to return per page, up to 100. Default is 50.
parameters.name: limit

amount.description: Money object: {amount, currency}. amount is in smallest currency unit.

budget_id.description: Budget this expense is charged to.

card_id.description: Card the expense was made with. Resolves via list_cards.

department_id.description: Department this expense is attributed to.

id.description: Expense ID. Use as expense_id in get_expense, update_expense, and upload_receipt.

location_id.description: Location this expense is attributed to.

merchant.description: Expanded merchant object (raw_descriptor, mcc, country) when expand=merchant.

receipts.description: Attached receipts when expand=receipts.download_uris. Each item has download_uri.

updated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the last update.

user_id.description: Owning user ID. Resolves via list_users.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. null/empty when there are no more pages.

list_users.description: List users in the Brex account, with an optional email filter. Use the user IDs from this action to create cards or to filter expenses and cards by user.
list_users.name: list_users

parameters.description: Filter to a user by email address.
parameters.name: email

parameters.description: Filter by the user's ID from your HR or sign-in system.
parameters.name: remote_display_id

parameters.description: To get the next page of results, enter the next_cursor value from the previous run.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: How many results to return per page, up to 100. Default is 50.
parameters.name: limit

id.description: User ID. Use as owner_user_id in create_card, as the user_id filter in list_expenses and list_cards, and (in future Tier 2 actions) as the target of set_user_limit.

location_id.description: Office location the user is assigned to.

manager_id.description: User ID of the user's manager. Resolves recursively via list_users.

status.description: User account status. Enum: INVITED, ACTIVE, CLOSED, DISABLED, DELETED, PENDING_ACTIVATION, INACTIVE, ARCHIVED.

title_id.description: Title ID (reference to a title object). Resolve via the Titles API.

update_expense.description: Update the memo on a card expense. The memo is the only field Brex allows this action to change.
update_expense.name: update_expense

parameters.description: The ID of the expense to update. You can find it with the List Brex expenses action.
parameters.name: expense_id

parameters.description: The new memo text. It replaces the existing memo; leave it empty to clear the memo.
parameters.name: memo

returns.description: Updated expense object. Subset of the full expense schema returned by get_expense.

upload_receipt.description: Upload a receipt file to Brex. If you provide an expense ID, the receipt is attached to that expense. Otherwise Brex matches it to an expense by amount, merchant, and date.
upload_receipt.name: upload_receipt

parameters.description: Filename including extension (e.g. 'receipt-2026-04-07.pdf').
parameters.name: receipt_name

parameters.description: The receipt file to upload (PDF, PNG, or JPG). You can attach a file or enter its file path.
parameters.name: file

parameters.description: Optional. The expense to attach the receipt to. You can find expense IDs with the List Brex expenses action. If left blank, Brex matches the receipt to an expense automatically.
parameters.name: expense_id

id.description: Brex receipt ID. Use to look up the matched expense via list_expenses with expand=receipts.download_uris.

matched_expense_id.description: Expense the receipt matched to. Null when match is still pending. Use as expense_id in get_expense / update_expense.

description: Manage Brex card spend, expenses, transactions, and virtual cards.
